meanings.meaning: A span is a short length of measure. It is the distance from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the little finger when the hand is stretched wide, about nine inches.
A span can also mean a length of time, from beginning to end. It can be a short stretch of time, such as the span of a life.
To span is to stretch across a space or a stretch of time, reaching from one end to the other. It can also mean to measure something with the hand stretched wide.
